decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - with appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposed development, by reason of size, scale and proportion, would not harm the appearance and design of the original house and would not be create obtrusive features harming either the street scene, the St.Paul's Close Conservation Area or the living conditions at neighbouring properties. The proposed development is therefore consistent with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions) and Section 7.0 (Conservation Areas) of Unitary Development Plan Supplementary Planning Guidance and the Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension and roof extension comprising side and rear dormers to house.
